scope: Metadata-only classification of exact public upstream attribution/author/provenance contact blobs. This approves no fixture, document, additional user content or distribution-rights waiver.

evidence_basis.meaning: Exact asset references and supplier artifacts are bound by the already authenticated r2 review/input inventory. Classification does not relabel or regenerate its candidate result.

policy_limits: Only exact whole-blob SHA256 values in the static data module are eligible; no dynamic path/review trust or directory exclusion.
Only explicit repository-source email context may use the data. Core-fixture privacy checking remains strict by default.
SSN, PAN including candidate guard, IBAN, MRZ and unapproved-document detection remain active. None occur in these exact reviewed blobs.
LF/CRLF forms are admitted only by their exact observed whole-blob digests; normalization does not expand the set.
Contacts are public upstream licence/author/contributor/vendor-source/schema attributions, not applicant or user-document information.
